name: Windows XP (Luna)
framework: Windows XP · Luna Blue visual style (Win32 common controls v6, shell)

elements.name: AddressBar
elements.doc: Address combo with its label: AddressBar("C:\\Documents and Settings")

elements.name: AllProgramsButton
elements.doc: All Programs ▸ with the green arrow

elements.name: Balloon
elements.doc: Notification balloon pointing at its child: Balloon("Updates are ready", message: "…") { TrayIcon("shield") }

elements.name: BrandGlyph
elements.doc: A neutral waving-flag glyph standing in for the system logo (Welcome screen, About boxes)

elements.name: CategoryLink
elements.doc: Control Panel category: CategoryLink("Appearance and Themes", systemImage: "photo") — 32 px icon and blue text

elements.name: CheckBox
elements.doc: 13 px box with the green check: CheckBox("Show hidden files", checked: true)

elements.name: ComboBox
elements.doc: Drop-down combo with the blue arrow button: ComboBox("Size", items:, selection:)

elements.name: DateTimePicker
elements.doc: Date picker field with the drop-down arrow

elements.name: Desktop
elements.doc: The desktop with a sky-and-hill wallpaper; place windows and icons with .position(x:y:)

elements.name: DesktopIcon
elements.doc: DesktopIcon("My Computer", systemImage: "computer") — 32 px icon over a white shadowed label; .selected()

elements.name: DialogBody
elements.doc: Root of a dialog screen: the frame's title bar keeps only Close (and ? with .variant(.help)).

elements.name: FileIcon
elements.doc: FileIcon("Budget.xls", systemImage: "doc") · .variant(.tiles) puts the name beside a 32 px icon

elements.name: Frame
elements.doc: Group box: thin rounded frame with a blue caption (also GroupBox)

elements.name: GoButton
elements.doc: The green Go arrow beside the address bar

elements.name: IconView
elements.doc: Icons / Tiles view: a grid of FileIcon

elements.name: ListBox
elements.doc: Single-selection list box with a sunken border

elements.name: ListView
elements.doc: Details view: columns:, rows:, sortColumn:, selectedRows:

elements.name: MenuBarItem
elements.doc: A menu bar title; .selected() when its menu is open

elements.name: MessageBox
elements.doc: Modal message box: MessageBox("Disk Cleanup", message: "…", systemImage: "exclamationmark.triangle", severity: .warning, buttons: ["OK"])

elements.name: MonthCalendar
elements.doc: Month calendar with the blue title band

elements.name: NotificationArea
elements.doc: The light-blue tray at the right of the taskbar: TrayIcon… Clock

elements.name: OptionButton
elements.doc: Radio button with the green dot (also RadioButton)

elements.name: ProgressBar
PropertyRow
elements.doc: A label: value line in a property sheet

elements.name: PushButton
elements.doc: 75×23 rounded button; .variant(.default) draws the blue default-button glow, .state(.hover) the orange one

elements.name: QuickLaunch
elements.doc: Quick Launch toolbar: small IconButtons beside Start

elements.name: StartButton
elements.doc: The green Start button (.selected() while the menu is open)

elements.name: StartMenu
elements.doc: Two-column Start menu: StartMenu("Alex", avatar: "Alex") { StartMenuPrograms{…} StartMenuPlaces{…} } actions: { LogOffButton() TurnOffButton() }

elements.name: StartMenuPlaces
elements.doc: The light-blue right column (My Documents, Control Panel, Help, Search, Run…)

elements.name: StartMenuPrograms
elements.doc: The white left column of the Start menu (pinned and frequent programs)

elements.name: StatusBar
elements.doc: Window status bar of sunken StatusBarPanels

elements.name: TabControl
elements.doc: Property-sheet tabs with the orange hot-track line on the selected tab
elements.sample: TabControl() { Text("First tab").tabItem { Text("One") }; Text("Second tab").tabItem { Text("Two") } }

elements.name: TabPage
elements.sample: TabView { TabPage("Inbox") { Text("Inbox content") }; TabPage("Archive") { Text("Archive content") } }

elements.name: TaskPane
elements.doc: Explorer's blue common-tasks pane holding TaskPaneSections

elements.name: TaskPaneSection
elements.doc: Collapsible task box: TaskPaneSection("File and Folder Tasks") { TaskLink(…) } · .variant(.special) for the dark-blue header

elements.name: Taskbar
elements.doc: The blue taskbar: StartButton, QuickLaunch, TaskbarButton…, Spacer, NotificationArea

elements.name: TaskbarButton
elements.doc: A window's taskbar button; .selected() for the active window

elements.name: ToolBar
elements.doc: Explorer's Standard Buttons toolbar (flat buttons, raised on hover)

elements.name: TrackBar
elements.doc: Slider with the pointed thumb: TrackBar(value: 30, in: 0...100, ticks: 10)

elements.name: TreeView
elements.doc: Folders tree with dotted lines and +/− boxes

elements.name: TurnOffButton
elements.doc: Start menu / Welcome screen: the red power button

elements.name: UserTile
elements.doc: A user picture and name on the Welcome screen: UserTile("Alex", subtitle: "Type your password", image: …)

elements.name: WelcomeBand
elements.doc: Dark blue band at the top or bottom of the Welcome screen

elements.name: WelcomeScreen
elements.doc: The blue Welcome (log-on) screen: header band, centre, footer band

elements.name: Window
elements.doc: A Luna window drawn inside a Desktop: blue title bar with min/max/close. Window("My Computer", systemImage: "computer") { … } · .variant(.inactive | .dialog | .tool)

elements.name: Wizard
elements.doc: Wizard page: white header band (title, subtitle:, systemImage:), body, and actions: { < Back · Next > · Cancel }

elements.name: Alert
elements.sample: Alert("Delete this draft?", message: "The draft and its attachments will be removed permanently.", actions: { Button("Cancel", role: .cancel); Button("Delete", role: .destructive) })

elements.name: Canvas
elements.doc: free-form area; place children with .position(x:y:); grid: .dots|.lines

elements.name: Dialog
elements.sample: Dialog("Rename file", message: "Enter a new name for the report.", actions: { Button("Cancel"); Button("Rename") }) { TextField("Name", text: "Quarterly report") }

elements.name: Grid
elements.doc: Grid of GridRow children, or columns: n

elements.name: KanbanCard
elements.doc: title, description:, tags: [..], assignees: [..], due:, comments:, priority:

elements.name: MessageBubble
elements.doc: MessageBubble("Hi", from: .me|.them, author:, time:, status:, reactions: [..])
elements.sample: MessageBubble("Running ten minutes late because the train stopped outside the station, so please start the meeting without me.", author: "Ana Lima", time: "09:41")

elements.name: NavigationSplitView
Placeholder
elements.doc: A labelled box for maps, charts, media

elements.name: SelectionRect
elements.doc: a drag-selection rectangle; size with .frame, place with .position

elements.name: Sheet
Spreadsheet
elements.doc: rows: [[…]], selection: "B2:C4", active:, formula:, sheets: [..], highlight: ["B3": .yellow]

elements.name: Tab
TabView
elements.sample: TabView() { Text("First tab").tabItem { Text("One") }; Text("Second tab").tabItem { Text("Two") } }

elements.name: Tabs
elements.sample: Tabs(["One", "Two", "Three"]) { Text("First tab").tabItem { Text("One") }; Text("Second tab").tabItem { Text("Two") } }

elements.name: Toast
elements.sample: Toast("Message sent", description: "Your reply reached 3 people.", action: "Undo", systemImage: "checkmark.circle")

elements.name: Tooltip
elements.sample: Tooltip("Share a link to this page") { Button("Share", systemImage: "square.and.arrow.up") }

elements.name: TreeItem
elements.doc: label, systemImage:, folder:, expanded:, selected:, detail:

elements.name: VideoPlayer
elements.doc: poster image, progress: 0…1, time:, duration:, playing:
